Maya Singh: Heads-up: Orchid Labs goes live Wed 09:00 PT. Can we assemble a short customer one-pager + internal quick-runbook for prefills, batching, streaming fallback, and renewal-risk signals? Need something ops-friendly.

Ethan Brooks: Yes. Keep the customer doc ~1 page and non-technical. Internal runbook should list exact flags + curl examples. Also note Orchid handles patient data -> prefill must be explicit opt-in.

Rhea Patel: Drafting internal knobs. Short version below.

Rhea Patel: PREFILL (internal):
- prefill_window: 10m before first traffic spike
- max_prefill_workers: 2 per tenant
- prefill_rate_limit: 3 reqs/min/tenant
- prompts: ["welcome","recent-activity-scan"]
- kv_prefix: "tenant:orchid-55:*"
- kv_ttl: 18m
- consent_required: true (account.prefill_consent = true)

Tom Alvarez: BATCHING + CACHING: keep batches small to start
- target_batch_size: 5 (scale up to 10 if p50 token latency < 100ms)
- backpressure_cutoff: 800ms (reduce batch size when avg token latency > cutoff)
- cache_priority: reuse embeddings when available; cache TTL for embeddings = 12h

Ethan Brooks: STREAMING FALLBACK RULES:
- keep stream enabled if tenant p95 token latency < 350ms
- if p95 > 650ms for 3m OR error_rate > 3% for 10m -> disable streaming for tenant, mark event stream_fallback(reason)
- when fallback occurs, route requests to non-stream endpoint and tag responses with fallback_reason metadata

Maya Singh: RENEWAL & ONBOARDING SIGNALS (CS-owned):
- onboarding_utilization: expected vs actual; flag onboarding_risk when actual < 12% by day 7
- activation_error_spike: error_rate > 2.5% sustained for 24h -> onboarding_risk=true
- low_engagement: DAU < 8 for 7 consecutive days in first 14 days
- allow account.webhooks["onboard_status"] = (ok|at_risk|opt_out) for tooling

Tom Alvarez: Quick ops toggles (internal endpoints):
```
# toggle prefill
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/internal/v1/tenants/orchid-55/prefill_toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"enable":false}'

# set consent
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/internal/v1/tenants/orchid-55 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prefill_consent":false}'
```

Rhea Patel: CLIENT GUIDANCE (share with Orchid):
- Use streaming for progressive UI; accept partial chunks and render progressively.
- Implement exponential backoff with jitter for reconnects. Short JS snippet for SDK:
```
let tries = 0;
function startSSE(){
  const s = new EventSource(url);
  s.onopen = () => { tries = 0; };
  s.onerror = () => { s.close(); tries++; setTimeout(startSSE, Math.min(30000, 500 * 2**tries)); };
}
startSSE();
```
- If no tokens arrive in 12s, client should call non-stream endpoint as fallback.

CS-Bot: Saved draft -> https://rw-internal.atlassian.net/orchid-onboard (access: customer-success, eng-runtime).

Maya Singh: ACTIONS: Ethan -> prepare 1-page customer doc (remove internal endpoints); Rhea -> add runbook to docs with knobs and telemetry; Tom -> ensure toggle endpoints have RBAC and test coverage; I'll draft a short renewal outreach for at-risk accounts.

Ethan Brooks: I will post the customer-facing one-pager here by EOD today. :white_check_mark:

Tom Alvarez: I'll run the toggle test in staging now and report back.

Maya Singh: Thanks everyone. If we see onboarding_risk flagged, CS will reach out within 48h with offer to pause prefill + schedule a 20-min enablement call.
